definitions.explanation: Mental torment, used almost only in {良心|りょうしん}の{呵責|かしゃく}, the pangs of conscience felt after doing wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{良心|りょうしん}→良心：13948_ryoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呵責|かしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{嘘|うそ}をついて→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧、⟦{良心|りょうしん}→良心：13948_ryoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呵責|かしゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんだ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: After lying, I was tormented by my conscience.
He went on deceiving people without the slightest remorse.
